scope: Native ordered boundary-before-motion field-equation and membership components, including exact genesis and no-motion closure. Supplied numerical removals/controls are not accepted consensus history. No extraction/composed-security theorem, qualified integer execution, full duration, ledger finality, settlement or full-game admission.

measurementScope.wholeChild: Includes source compilation and all component work; no network or finalized ledger.
measurementScope.provingComponent: Timed commit plus prove, after prepare; includes commitment to the original value oracle.
measurementScope.verificationComponent: Timed generic sequence preparation plus native component verification.
measurementScope.rss: Whole individual child process RSS from /usr/bin/time -l, not a tracked-allocation bound.
